title: Salesforce Signs Definitive Agreement to Acquire Braze
summary: Salesforce agreed to buy Braze for about $5.66B in enterprise value ($47.50 per share in cash, roughly a 58% premium) to add real-time, cross-channel personalization to Marketing Cloud and Data 360; closing is expected in Salesforce's fiscal 2028. Braze's Operator Connect (beta) already lets marketers run campaigns from MCP-compatible tools like Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot.

title: FTC Order Preserves Competition in Digital Advertising Ecosystem as Part of Publicis's Acquisition of LiveRamp
summary: The FTC voted 2-0 to accept a five-year consent order that clears Publicis's $2.2B purchase of LiveRamp, requiring neutral access to LiveRamp's standalone products, firewalls around customer data and independent audits; the deal is expected to close by end of 2026. WPP is reportedly winding down LiveRamp use and Omnicom has accelerated plans to drop it.

title: Blocking Identity Resolution Infrastructure
summary: Apple detailed how Safari in its version 27 operating systems blocks, at the domain level, third parties that convert login/sign-up emails into persistent cross-site tracking IDs, targeting the identity graphs behind post-cookie IDs. Vendors like The Trade Desk have set up backup domains, and IAB Tech Lab argues the move costs publishers revenue and pushes spend to walled gardens.

title: Netflix Ads Suite Has Better Buying, Better Planning, Better Results
summary: Netflix launched the Netflix Pixel and an expanded Conversion API supporting 20+ lower-funnel conversion events for measurement and audience building. From November, The Trade Desk buyers can target first- and third-party audiences on Netflix via Kokai, and Yahoo DSP buyers can now measure attribution on programmatic Netflix buys.

title: ChatGPT Ads Is Expanding To New Markets And Exploring New Ad Formats
summary: OpenAI is expanding ChatGPT Ads to 26 more countries, 14 in Latin America, and testing a larger-image ad format in the US for users generating images in ChatGPT.

title: Netflix cuts its ad target to $2.7bn as OpenAI turns on automatic ad rewrites
summary: From October 30, OpenAI will enable AI creative changes by default on self-serve ChatGPT ad campaigns, rewriting headlines and descriptions, translating, resizing images and swapping landing pages, sometimes in real time based on conversation context; advertisers can opt out in Ads Manager.

title: AWS Clean Rooms now supports Databricks as a data source
summary: AWS Clean Rooms can now query Databricks tables shared via Delta Sharing directly without copying data to S3, joining Glue, Snowflake and Athena as supported sources; AWS cites retailer-to-media-partner campaign measurement as a key use case.

title: Retail Media Platform Kevel Raises $52 Million With M&A On The Brain
summary: Retail media infrastructure provider Kevel raised a $52M Series D led by Fulcrum Equity Partners with Dunnhumby Ventures, Iberis Capital and ORIX USA, bringing total funding past $100M; the CEO plans to use some funds for acquisitions amid expected retail media consolidation.

title: Omnicom's Credera Announces Five-Year Strategic Collaboration with AWS to Transform Enterprise Marketing with AI and Cloud
summary: Omnicom's Credera signed a five-year strategic collaboration with AWS, creating a dedicated AWS business unit and planning 12-15 AWS Marketplace listings built on Amazon Bedrock and AWS Clean Rooms across martech, adtech and enterprise modernization.

title: Stagwell Launches "Stagwell AI," Its Unified Custom Portfolio of Agentic Marketing Solutions
source: ACCESS Newswire via Yahoo Finance (press release)
summary: Stagwell consolidated its agentic products under the Stagwell AI brand, including enterprise 'Machines' (Machine OS, The Targeting Machine, The Knowledge Machine, The Media Machine) and a new self-service tier for small businesses, backed by a multimillion-dollar campaign.

title: Google Ads Data Manager stops requiring hashed customer data November 16
summary: Per a Google email shared on LinkedIn, from November 16 Google Ads Data Manager will accept encrypted customer data by default instead of requiring SHA-256 hashing, decrypting and matching inside a trusted execution environment for Customer Match and enhanced conversions. Not yet confirmed by an official Google announcement.

title: AI Startup Minerva Built An Agentic CDP, But Don't Call It That
summary: Minerva, which recently raised $20M, uses an OpenAI-based 'agentic data engineer' to unify brand CRM and warehouse data into a single customer view enriched with its 270M-consumer identity graph, citing 3.4x ROAS gains on Meta lookalikes; a predictive-modeling agent is in development.

title: impact.com launches Contextual Ads for publishers
summary: impact.com launched Contextual Ads, placing CPC product ads from its 7,000+ brands into relevant shopping content via a publisher tag or API, live with Dianomi's premium publisher network in the US and UK.

title: AliExpress and YouTube Announce Global Strategic Affiliate Partnership
summary: AliExpress is expanding its YouTube affiliate partnership from South Korea to the US, UK, Germany and Brazil, letting eligible creators tag AliExpress products in videos, Shorts and livestreams via YouTube Studio for commission.

title: Investcorp Invests in Spanish Marketing Automation Company Connectif
summary: Investcorp Technology Partners acquired a majority stake in Connectif, a Spanish AI marketing automation platform for e-commerce serving 3,000+ brands; terms were not disclosed. It is ITP's first Spanish investment and sixth from Fund V.

title: Google Updates Financial Ad-Verification Process
summary: Google is expanding its Financial Services Verification program to the US and Canada with the American Bankers Association, requiring financial advertisers to prove regulator authorization before entering the auction; rollout is expected in early 2027.

title: How Amazon Ads Plans To Make Programmatic Simple Without Taking Control From Marketers
summary: Amazon Ads' Kelly MacLean says Amazon Ads Agent, its AI layer spanning the ad console and DSP, optimizes against an authenticated graph covering 90% of US households using real purchase signals, citing beta results of 18% lower CPMs and 16% lower CPAs.

title: Die nächste Stufe der Data Collaboration: Von Vernetzung zu Intelligence
summary: InfoSum SVP Daan Onland argues data collaboration is shifting from identity matching to combining live cross-partner signals, positioning private data networks and federated learning as the foundation for AI and agentic use cases while data stays with its owner.
